description: 1D dam break on a flat frictionless bed, h_l = 0.5 m, h_r = 0.05 m, dam at x = 20 m, hydrostatic SFLOW (A 220 0), WENO reconstruction; depth time series at 8 gauges for 0 < t < 4 s against the exact Stoker (wet bed) solution.

reference.citation: Stoker, J.J. (1957) Water Waves. Interscience; exact solution as in Delestre et al. (2013) SWASHES
